title: centaurea spachii subsp. lagascae
intro: Centaurea spachii subsp. lagascae, commonly known as a type of Knapweed, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea spachii subsp. lagascae include its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions such as fever, headache, and respiratory issues, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
